title: NHS AI blood test could reduce invasive womb cancer checks
slides: An NHS AI blood test: could it replace painful biopsies?
It analyzes DNA methylation from a single blood draw.
Detects womb cancer with 95% accuracy in early trials.
Thousands of invasive checks may soon be avoided entirely.
Ask your GP if this test is available near you.
thread_text:
The needle that sees cancer.

A single blood draw analyzed methylation patterns with 95% accuracy in early trials for womb cancer.

Your DNA holds a chemical timeline.

Methylation changes reveal tumor presence without cutting tissue—no biopsy needed.

Thousands of invasive checks vanish.

Painful biopsies could become obsolete if this NHS test rolls out nationally.

The twist: it caught 95% early.

Detection at stage one means treatment starts months sooner for many women.

Check your GP today.

Ask if the NHS AI blood test is available at your local clinic.

It reads your DNA's methylation marks.
Ask your doctor about the test.
